minutes.headline: Board of Health granted all three septic variance requests, with a four-bedroom deed restriction on 1480 Lancaster Ave.
minutes.summary: The remote Board of Health meeting heard three septic upgrade variance requests and granted each. The agent briefed the board on Covid-19 trends, the move back to a stricter reopening step, new quarantine periods and vaccine planning. The board also approved the November 16 minutes and discussed filling a vacancy.

what_happened.line: The Board of Health granted all three septic variance requests heard at its remote meeting, starting with 72 Maple Parkway.
For 1480 Lancaster Ave, the board granted three local upgrade approvals and one local variance on condition of a deed restriction to four bedrooms; the chair abstained.
The board granted the local upgrade approval for 112 South Row Road on a roll call vote of four ayes.
The board heard a Covid-19 update covering the move back to a stricter reopening step, new quarantine periods and vaccine planning.
Members approved the November 16 minutes and asked the public to contact the administrative assistant about serving on the board to fill an expected vacancy.

why_it_matters: The four-bedroom deed restriction on 1480 Lancaster Ave stays with the property and caps the size of the house on that septic system, which matters to future owners and buyers.
The board is expected to lose a member, and residents can apply to serve through the administrative assistant.
watch_next: An expected vacancy on the Board of Health: interested residents are asked to contact the administrative assistant.
